$comment: The GIAMIP compliance checker, which protocol section 6.3 requires every submission to pass. It is the authority on output variable names, units, long names, dtypes and plausible ranges: its GIAMIP_VARIABLES table transcribes the data request spreadsheet, which the protocol prose does not reproduce. Pinned so that a change upstream is a visible update here and not a silent change in what we validate against.
note: `commit` is the pinned version. The organisers announced on 2026-10-07 that the quality-check code is final. On 2026-10-09 the head of the repository was still 6207e06 of 2026-09-10, the commit that the output writer and variables.json were built against (`read_commit`), so the pin is that commit and nothing generated from the checker changes.
